sys_script_include.description: Returns the configured LLM provider for a purpose (blueprint, narrative, repair). Picks the active x_ddb_provider_config whose purpose matches, falling back to one with purpose "any". Lowest order wins. The API key is read lazily, only when a request is sent: 1. Connection & Credential alias named in credential_alias (sys_alias id such as "x_ddb.anthropic", or its sys_id), API Key credential attribute "api_key". 2. Otherwise the encrypted api_key field on the provider config.
sys_script_include.name: ProviderFactory
